senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to turn, cmp. טְוִי II,] to roast.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 5:9">Tosef. Pes. V, 9</cite> <he>בישלו … צְלָאוֹ</he> if he cooked (the Passover lamb) and then roasted it; <cite ref="Pesachim 41a:21">Pes. 41ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 41a:21">Ib.</cite> <he>צלאו כל צורכו</he> if he roasted it as much as needed (well-done, contrad. to <cite ref="N00003"><he>נא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:1">Ib. VII, 1</cite> <he>כיצד צוֹלִין וכ׳</he> how must the Passover lamb be roasted? <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>צא וצְלֵה לנו וכ׳</he> go out and roast the lamb for us &c. Y. ib. VII, beg. 34ᵃ <he>צְלָייוֹ בגדי וכ׳</he> if he roasted it together with a secular (not sacrificial) kid. Ib. bot. <he>בשר לִצְלוֹת</he> meat to roast it; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>צָלוּי</he>; f. <he>צְלוּיָה</he>, <he>צְלוּיָיה</he>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29a:8">Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ביצה צ׳</he> a roasted egg; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be roasted. Y. Pes. l. c. נִצְלָה מקצתו וכ׳ if it was roasted partly by the heat of the stove &c.; a. fr.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:10">Sabb. I, 10</cite> <he>כדי שיִצּוֹלוּ וכ׳</he> (fr. <cite ref="R00192"><he>צול</he></cite>) in time to be roasted before the Sabbath begins.
